summary: Micware Co., Ltd., a Japan-based automotive IVI software developer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026 furnishing a press release and investor presentation regarding planned participation in three investor events: a non-deal roadshow on September 10-11, 2026 in New York hosted by A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners; the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on September 14-16, 2026; and the Emerging Growth Virtual Conference on September 24, 2026. This is a routine investor-relations communication, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor engagement are stated. Watch for any subsequent capital-markets activity that might follow the roadshow.
